# Hand Luggage Only

> > A travel, food, and photography blog featuring destination guides, hotel reviews, and adventure stories from around the world.

Hand Luggage Only documents personal travel experiences across Europe, Asia, Africa, and South America, with detailed guides to destinations like Spain, Peru, Sri Lanka, and Switzerland. The blog combines practical travel advice with stunning photography and culinary discoveries.

## Key Topics

- Spain travel destinations
- Peru and Lake Titicaca
- Sri Lanka adventures
- Switzerland and Swiss lakes
- European city guides
- Luxury hotel and resort reviews
- Restaurant and food experiences
- Travel photography
- Weekend trips and getaways
- South American exploration
- African safaris
- Maldives island luxury
- Historic landmarks and UNESCO sites
- Coastal hiking and nature
- Unique accommodations
